title: Test meta.json
description: Schema for test case metadata (meta.json) in the SysProLang compiler test suite.

$schema.description: JSON schema reference for editor LSP support (relative path to meta.schema.json).

grammar.description:
Grammar version constraint(s) for this test case.

- A string like "1", ">=4", "<=2", "==3" applies to all stages.
- A list of strings like ["1", "2"] applies to all stages.
- A dict mapping stage names to constraints allows per-stage rules.

stages.description:
List of stages to run for this test case.

Possible values: "lexer", "parser", "llvm", "compiler", "run".
If absent, stages are inferred from golden file presence or exit contracts.

exit.description:
Expected exit code(s) for test stages.

- "nonzero": any non-zero exit is accepted.
- An integer: exact exit code expected.
- A dict mapping stage names to exit specs allows per-stage expectations.
  The "run" stage exit falls back to "compiler" if not specified (backward compat).

exclude.description: If true, this test case is excluded from the test run.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for each stage of this test case (default: 30s).

tolerance.description: Floating-point tolerance for numeric output comparison (run stage only).

exitSpec.description: An exit code specification: "nonzero" or an exact integer.
